unreachableBlockerCodes.reason: Qualification requires known weight above zero, which requires at least one selected check, so the reference gate is defensive and no input reaches it. A second implementation need not emit it.

vectors.description: Every frozen check passes from one run signed by a self key; thresholds are met.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-001: a complete passing run scores the full denominator; KYA-REF-001: no blocker means an empty blockerCodes list.

vectors.description: All checks signed by an independent trust anchor meet an independent coverage floor of 1.
vectors.rationale: KYA-TRU-001: independence is the policy-assigned role of the signing key, and it counts toward independent coverage.

vectors.description: A fully passing run signed by a self key cannot meet an independent coverage floor of 0.5.
vectors.rationale: KYA-TRU-001: a receipt cannot assign itself independence; only the policy role does.

vectors.description: An independent run with one check omitted reaches coverage 0.8 but not an independent floor of 0.9.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-001: an omitted check stays in the denominator and cannot raise coverage; independence is measured on the same denominator.

vectors.description: No evidence at all against a profile with two critical checks.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-001: empty evidence stays insufficient, never qualified, with every critical check unproven.

vectors.description: Zero thresholds and no critical checks with empty evidence.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-002: zero thresholds still require at least one scored observation.

vectors.description: Every check abstains under zero thresholds and no critical checks.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-001: abstain earns no points and no coverage; KYA-SCO-002: at least one known pass or fail is required.

vectors.description: One critical check fails; the average would otherwise pass.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-002: a critical failure blocks whatever the average.

vectors.description: A critical failure under zero thresholds.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-002: a critical failure blocks even under zero thresholds.

vectors.description: A critical check has no evidence while coverage still reaches the floor.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-002: an unresolved critical check withholds qualification.

vectors.description: A critical check abstains.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-001: abstain is unknown, not pass; KYA-SCO-002: unresolved critical withholds qualification.

vectors.description: A critical check reports an error outcome.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-001: error earns no points and no coverage.

vectors.description: One critical check fails and the other has no evidence.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-002: the failure decides the decision; only the failure is named.

vectors.description: Two non-critical checks fail: coverage is complete but the score is 600 against a 700 floor.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-001: a sufficiently observed result below minScore is blocked with its own code.

vectors.description: One non-critical failure leaves 900 against a 700 floor.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-001: a non-critical failure costs its weight but does not itself block.

vectors.description: Score 800 against minScore 800 qualifies.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-001: the score gate is strict less-than; equality qualifies.

vectors.description: Score 800 against minScore 801 is blocked.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-001: one point below the floor is blocked.

vectors.description: A check is omitted instead of failing; score stays 800 with upper bound 1000 and coverage 0.8 misses a 0.9 floor.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-001: removing a check from the evidence cannot improve the result; the denominator is fixed.

vectors.description: Only three of six checks observed: coverage 0.6, score 600, upper bound 1000.
vectors.rationale: KYA-SCO-001: unknown checks keep their weight in the denominator and in the upper bound.

vectors.description: A named check meets its pass minimum.
vectors.rationale: KYA-MIN-002: a met minimum leaves the decision unchanged.

vectors.description: A named non-critical check fails while score and coverage would qualify.
vectors.rationale: KYA-MIN-002: an unmet minimum caps the result at blocked whatever the score, naming a finding.

vectors.description: A named check has no evidence; score and coverage would qualify.
vectors.rationale: KYA-MIN-003: removing evidence cannot satisfy a minimum; the gap is named separately from a finding.

vectors.description: A named check abstains.
vectors.rationale: KYA-MIN-002: abstain is not a pass; it is an unproven gap.

vectors.description: A named check passes, but the run is signed by a self key and the minimum is independent-pass.
vectors.rationale: KYA-MIN-002: a pass without the required independence is NOT_MET, a finding rather than a gap.

vectors.description: The whole run is signed by an independent key and the minimum is independent-pass.
vectors.rationale: KYA-MIN-002: an independent pass from the selected run satisfies an independent-pass minimum.

vectors.description: A named check is evidenced only by a declaration.
vectors.rationale: KYA-MIN-003: a declaration cannot satisfy a minimum, because a declaration is rejected before scoring.
